text.Title: Off the Books
text.Description: Lieutenant Mara Voss needs an Arasaka-affiliated contractor eliminated and his encrypted records recovered. This is an off-duty operation. Any police response is your responsibility. Retrieve the evidence, lose any pursuing officers, and return to Voss.
text.ShardHint: Restricted authorization logs and personnel transfer records.
text.ShardBody:
Classification: Restricted

Authorization logs and personnel transfer records.

Several entries have been deleted or redacted.

Receiving department: [REDACTED]
Transfer authority: Corporate Security Liaison
Disposition: External custody

Two transfer references have no corresponding intake records. Their authorization signatures match the retained transaction logs.

Distribution outside authorized personnel is prohibited.
